responsibility: Implements the scalar VFP machine-description patterns for Arm. It defines data moves between core and VFP registers, FP16-aware variants, scalar floating-point arithmetic, comparisons, min/max, conversions, FPSCR access, literal-pool avoidance splits, and CDE instructions that use VFP/MVE register classes, forming the main lowering layer for scalar VFP operations separate from NEON vector support.
